attribution-off.summary: Leave Claude Code's name out of your commits and pull requests
attribution-off.why: It turns attribution off, so your commits and pull requests hold only what you and your project put there.

claudeCode.whenMissing: Attribution is on: Claude Code adds a co-author line to your commits and "Generated with Claude Code" to your pull requests, and cloud and Remote Control sessions add a link to the session.
claudeCode.whenOlderForm: Attribution is partly off: Claude Code leaves out the co-author line and "Generated with Claude Code", but cloud and Remote Control sessions still add a link to the session.
claudeCode.whenOther: Attribution is set your own way: Claude Code adds what that value says, in place of its own lines.

feedback-survey-off.summary: Turn off Claude Code's session quality survey
feedback-survey-off.why: It turns the survey off, so it never interrupts your work or asks to upload a transcript.

claudeCode.whenMissing: The survey is on: Claude Code now and then asks you to rate the session, and can ask to upload its transcript.
claudeCode.whenOther: The survey is on at that rate, from 0 for never to 1 for every time it can: Claude Code asks you to rate the session, and can ask to upload its transcript.

remote-control-at-startup.summary: Connect Remote Control when each Claude Code session starts
remote-control-at-startup.why: It turns Remote Control on at startup, so you can pick up any session from claude.ai/code or the Claude app, with nothing to run first.

claudeCode.whenMissing: Remote Control is off at startup: it connects only when you run /remote-control, unless your organization or Claude Code turns it on for everyone.
claudeCode.whenOther: Remote Control is off at startup: it connects only when you run /remote-control, unless your organization turns it on for everyone.
claudeCode.needs: It needs a claude.ai sign-in on a Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise plan, and on Team and Enterprise, an Owner must turn Remote Control on first. Where it can't connect, each session shows a notice; switch it off in /config.
